Translation: 抑郁丹尼：\n我的生活一直走下坡路\n自从萨曼莎甩了我之后。

Translation: 抑郁丹尼：\n你只是被迫才来的。\n没人会专门来看我...

Title: NETMESSAGE:Tropical Trevor:\nWhat great weather we're having.\nI think might have to take off my metal diaper.
